name: Vaklin
description: Vaklin was a planet located in the Vaklin system of the Inner Rim Territories and the homeworld of Shula Shevu. A world deeply-seated in pro-Jedi tradition, the planet was initially resistant to anti-Jedi propaganda by the Galactic Empire, but eventually succumbed to pressures from Darth Vader.
